name.ja: ピカちんキット09 びっくりカンカン

description.ja: • ターゲットの気をそらしてピンチを回避したいキミへ！
description.en: • For you who want to avoid a pinch by distracting your target!

description.ja: • ド派手な音と動きで敵を撃退できる最強の武器！
description.en: • The most powerful weapon that can repel enemies with flashy sounds and movements!

description.ja: • テレビ番組「ポチっと発明 ピカちんキット」に登場するびっくりカンカンが商品化！
description.en: • The surprising can-can that appears on the TV program "Pochitto Invention Pikachin Kit" has been commercialized!

description.ja: • 時間が経つと音をたててバラバラになるドリンク缶の発明品！
description.en: • An invention of a drink can that makes noise and falls apart over time!

description.ja: • ピカちん大百科に綴じられるピカちんシートも付いてくるぞ！
description.en: • It also comes with a Pikachin sheet that can be bound into the Pikachin Encyclopedia!
